tt-riveter.name: XM orbital riveting machines, rivets Ø3/16 – 1-3/16″
tt-riveter.summary: Hydraulic orbital (rolling) riveters: the riveting head rolls the rivet end into shape instead of hammering it, with about a tenth of the force of punch riveting — the part keeps its fit, the head comes out smooth, without vibration or noise. Six sizes for solid rivets from 3/16 to 1-3/16″; with other tools the machine works as a normal press. Hinges, chain links, brake parts, appliances and hardware.

Tables Ø4.7″ to 19.7 × 14″
